stem: Ojas dissolves 6 spoons of sugar in 300 mL of water. Kavya dissolves 2 spoons of sugar in 300 mL of water. Both stir until all the sugar dissolves.

parts.text: Which claim about the two solutions is correct?

options.text: Ojas has more solute in the same amount of solvent, so his solution is more concentrated.
Both solutions have the same concentration because both use 300 mL of water.
Ojas's solution is more concentrated because his glass looks darker.
Kavya's solution is more concentrated because it has less sugar.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: For the same amount of water, more dissolved sugar means a more concentrated solution.

teacher.key_rationale: Concentration compares solute amount in a fixed quantity of solvent. Equal water alone does not equalise concentration; darkness is a surface cue; less sugar is more dilute.
